output.reason: Several days of brief positional spinning that settles suggests a triggered positional vertigo, and the remaining clinician task — positional testing and a repositioning plan — can start in messaging rather than requiring emergency or same-day in-person care.
output.patientMessage: Your dizziness sounds positional — brief spinning when you roll over or turn your head, settling on its own. I've asked a Counsel clinician to review this thread and advise on positional testing and a repositioning maneuver. Meanwhile, move slowly and avoid driving during spells. If you develop slurred speech, weakness, vision change, severe headache, constant spinning, or trouble walking, call 911.
differential: Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo (positional trigger, brief episodes)
Central positional vertigo — cannot be excluded without positional examination
output.vitalSigns: No blood pressure, heart rate or other readings were reported; whether any were measured is unknown.
output.evidenceLimitations: Episode duration, nystagmus characteristics and positional-test findings are unreported, so no diagnosis-specific criteria are confirmed.

citations.claim: Brief vertigo triggered by rolling over in bed or head movement is the classic positional-vertigo pattern.
citations.limitation: Episode duration under one minute and positional testing are not established for this patient.
